description: Corrected the initialization mapping bug in the `Block` class where `self.resid_lambdas` (the class dictionary attribute) were incorrectly assigned to the forward pass parameters (`self.x` and `self.x0`) instead of the class dictionary attributes (`self.resid_lambdas`). This caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on the first step with empty tensors, crashing the training loop and reducing the val_bpb from 0.9912 to 0.9910.
